title: Culture-Aware Humorous Captioning: Multimodal Humor Generation across Cultural Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models on a cross-cultural benchmark to compare their ability to generate appropriate humorous captions and maintain 'Contextual Fit' under explicit Western versus Eastern cultural constraints, thereby measuring the models' default bias toward high-resource Western contexts.

Controlling for cross-lingual mismatch by using language-specific prompts (English for the Western context, Chinese for the Eastern context) to mitigate and analyze whether performance differences stem from cultural understanding rather than purely linguistic constraints.
